name: R-H to hydrogen acceptor
summary: A 10-step route from R-H to hydrogen acceptor, ingested from Rhea. Every step is curated by Rhea and independently verified here to balance in mass and charge.

reactions.name: unspecific monooxygenase
reactions.equation: an organic molecule + reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + O2 = an alcohol + oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + H2O + H(+)

reactions.equation: 7-oxoheptanoyl-[ACP] + oxidized [flavodoxin] + H2O = 6-carboxyhexanoyl-[ACP] + reduced [flavodoxin]

reactions.name: 8-amino-7-oxononanoate synthase
reactions.equation: 6-carboxyhexanoyl-[ACP] + L-alanine + H(+) = (8S)-8-amino-7-oxononanoate + holo-[ACP] + CO2
